name: How long does it take to get a damaged home ready for sale or a rental ready for move-in?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to get a damaged home ready for sale or a rental ready for move-in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on how much damage is involved, but smaller cosmetic repairs can often be completed quickly, while larger restoration work takes longer. If you have a deadline for listing or a new tenant move-in, the best move is to schedule the assessment early so the repair plan fits the timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small prep repairs may be quick, but bigger damage takes longer. If you have a listing or move-in deadline, book the assessment early so the work can be prioritized correctly.
